facts.text: Mike Flanagan's first reaction when offered Carrie was essentially "Why?!"; he took it on anyway as a challenge, with Stephen King's blessing.
The story is moved to the present day, so Carrie's bullies have smartphones and social media, and online bullying becomes a central theme.
In King's 1974 novel Carrie's father is never in the picture; the series reimagines Ralph White as a character.
Carrie is one of King's shortest novels, so the eight-episode miniseries expands the roles of nearly every character and adds new ones.
